name: Become SCP-096
desc:
In this game, you can play as SCP-096. As 096, you can wander the landscape and kill any human that upsets you.
You can also play as a human, you get given tools to survive and explore.

Controls are listed inside of the game in the settings menu. ⚙

When buying a private server, you are entitled to the HD Admin VIP commands in that server only.
Type ";cmds" in chat to view your commands. ⚙

DISCLAIMER: Not all models, sounds, and animations were made by me.

Game can be quite buggy sometimes :/ 🛠
Many features are still yet to arrive. 📝
